approval.evidence: Owner message on 2026-08-31 approved the combined Skill Supply visual result, design-system adoption, and exact-preview production promotion.

intent: Make a capable person's market value legible through an honest, proof-first career instrument that feels sharp, warm, direct, and unlike an HR portal.
northStar: Paste a messy background in and receive a sharp resume, a defensible one-liner, and five named companies worth pitching, with the human retaining control of every external action.

personality.signature: A restrained transfer-market editorial with the precision of a career agent's working desk: monochrome, candid, proof-heavy, and punctuated by one indigo signal color.
mustPreserve: The sharp and warm anti-HR voice.
Monochrome chrome with restrained indigo data accents.
The Geist Sans and Geist Mono contrast.
Human control over applications and external communication.

color.strategy: Hierarchy comes from typography, spacing, and proof. Chrome stays monochrome. Indigo is a scarce signal for the mark, selected data, focus, and decisive state. Sentiment colors describe real outcomes, not compatibility scores.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: The page and full-width reading surfaces.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Body copy, headings, and primary interface labels.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Forms, reports, and overlays only when containment clarifies function.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary surfaces and supporting metadata, paired with the matching muted foreground token.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline structure where spacing alone cannot communicate grouping.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Wordmark dot, selected data, pull-quote rules, focus, and active states. Never a large surface or default button fill.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: True errors and destructive actions, never ordinary low fit.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Completed or verified positive outcomes, not decorative reassurance.

typography.strategy: Geist Sans carries reading and direct action. Geist Mono marks navigation, market evidence, sequence, scores, timestamps, and the wordmark. Hierarchy is typographic, not ornamental.

families.usage: Body copy, headings, form controls, and buttons.
Navigation, eyebrows, scores, timestamps, sequences, and the wordmark.

scale.name: subheading
scale.usage: Named findings, targets, and step titles.

scale.name: body
scale.usage: Primary reading copy and form guidance.

scale.name: label
scale.usage: Mono eyebrows and compact evidence labels. Never below 12px for essential text.

spacing.density: Generous editorial whitespace around compact evidence and controls.

shape.border: One-pixel neutral hairlines. Use borders only when whitespace cannot explain the boundary.
shape.elevation: Nearly flat. Use overlays with a restrained shadow, not floating card stacks.
shape.signatureShape: Square editorial blocks with modest rounding on inputs and controls.

layout.strategy: A centered 768px editorial measure. Full-width bands are rare. Internal content reflows from one mobile column to bounded desktop compositions without hiding core work.

motion.principle: Motion explains progress, change, or causality. It never decorates waiting or reading.
motion.reducedMotion: All non-essential animation and smooth scrolling become instantaneous under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

focus.rule: Every interactive element has a visible focus-visible state with at least WCAG 2.2 AA non-text contrast.

imagery.direction: Show the work: resumes, target lists, fit evidence, market data, and verified outcomes. Let evidence carry the visual interest.
allowed: Simple diagrams that explain the agent's work.
forbidden: Abstract gradients used to imply intelligence.

patterns.name: candidate-input
patterns.intent: Make it safe and obvious to provide a messy background without pretending the data is already polished.
rules: State what can be pasted and what remains private.
Keep the primary input and primary action in one visual field.
Never place an API key or personal background into analytics.

patterns.name: agent-progress
patterns.intent: Reveal useful progress without fake precision or distracting motion.
rules: Name the current work in plain language.
Use indigo only for the active signal.
Allow the user to stop or recover when the process fails.

patterns.name: evidence-report
patterns.intent: Turn a career judgment into inspectable evidence and a clear next move.
rules: Lead with the candidate's strongest truthful positioning.
Separate fact, inference, uncertainty, and recommendation.
Use direct labels instead of color-only meaning.
Make copying and sharing explicit actions.

patterns.name: human-control-gate
patterns.intent: Keep the candidate visibly responsible for every application and external communication.
rules: Describe what the agent prepared and what it did not send.
Require human review before the final external action.
Never imply that an application was submitted when it was only drafted.

content.voice: A brilliant friend who understands the market: sharp, warm, candid, and useful. Never an HR department and never a motivational poster.
rules: Use short declarative sentences and concrete nouns.
Say what the evidence supports and name uncertainty.
Prefer honest fit, gap, proof, target, and next move language.
State that candidates never pay wherever pricing ambiguity could occur.
State human control wherever external communication could be inferred.
Use commas, colons, periods, and parentheses instead of em or en dashes.
bannedPatterns: Passionate, perfect fit, rockstar, ninja, and world-class.
Copy that implies autonomous sending or applying.

responsiveRules.name: mobile-first-reflow
responsiveRules.rule: At 390px, navigation, forms, reports, tables, and actions reflow without horizontal scrolling or clipped essential content.
responsiveRules.acceptance: Document width equals viewport width and the audit reports zero offscreen essential text.

responsiveRules.name: comfortable-actions
responsiveRules.rule: All controls are at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels. Primary mobile actions and dense standalone controls target 44 by 44 CSS pixels.
responsiveRules.acceptance: Automated geometry audit reports zero controls below 24px and human review confirms comfortable primary actions at 390px.

responsiveRules.name: desktop-measure
responsiveRules.rule: At 1440px, the main reading measure remains bounded and evidence never stretches into an unreadable line length.
responsiveRules.acceptance: The primary content remains at or below 768px except for explicitly labelled comparative graphics.

responsiveRules.name: same-capability
responsiveRules.rule: Mobile and desktop expose the same core candidate workflow and evidence. Layout may change, capability may not disappear.
responsiveRules.acceptance: The audit's route and interaction matrix passes at both 390x844 and 1440x900.

accessibility.name: contrast
accessibility.rule: Text and controls meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast in light and dark themes, including focus, error, warning, and positive states.
accessibility.acceptance: Automated checks pass and the final human review verifies no meaning depends on subtle gray alone.

accessibility.name: keyboard
accessibility.rule: Every action is reachable, named, operable, and visibly focused by keyboard in a logical order.
accessibility.acceptance: A keyboard-only pass reaches the complete candidate flow without traps or invisible focus.

accessibility.name: reduced-motion
accessibility.rule: Reduced-motion preference disables smooth scrolling and all non-essential transitions or animation.
accessibility.acceptance: The identical mobile and desktop audit reports zero reduced-motion violations.

accessibility.name: semantic-status
accessibility.rule: Progress, errors, and completion are announced semantically and never communicated by color alone.
accessibility.acceptance: Screen-reader inspection identifies labels, status changes, errors, and recovery actions.

accessibility.name: readable-type
accessibility.rule: Essential text is at least 12px. Body copy targets 16px with a readable measure and line height.
accessibility.acceptance: Automated type audit reports zero essential text below 12px at 390px and 1440px.

influences.title: Linear
influences.author: Linear design team
influences.principle: Use near-monochrome surfaces and reserve one accent for meaningful state.
influences.take: Let weight, spacing, and evidence carry hierarchy. Spend indigo only when it communicates a decision or active state.
influences.doNotCopy: Do not copy Linear's layout, gradients, component shapes, animation, assets, or trade dress.

influences.title: Vitsoe
influences.author: Vitsoe
influences.principle: Treat restraint and longevity as a product position.
influences.take: Prefer durable typography, clear structure, and proof over seasonal visual novelty.
influences.doNotCopy: Do not copy Vitsoe's product photography, grid, typography treatment, assets, or trade dress.

influences.title: GOV.UK Design System
influences.author: Government Digital Service
influences.principle: A pattern should carry research, usage conditions, and a retirement path.
influences.take: Record the evidence and acceptance conditions behind career-flow patterns instead of treating the component library as the system.
influences.doNotCopy: Do not copy GOV.UK components, crown identity, typography, content, or visual trade dress.

influences.title: Shopify Polaris
influences.author: Shopify design team
influences.principle: Content guidance is a first-class design-system layer.
influences.take: Encode candid voice rules, error formulas, human-control language, and banned recruiting cliches alongside visual tokens.
influences.doNotCopy: Do not copy Polaris components, layouts, illustrations, tokens, or Shopify trade dress.

influences.title: Daring Fireball
influences.author: John Gruber
influences.principle: A clear measure, strong voice, and minimal vocabulary can remain legible for decades.
influences.take: Keep the editorial spine and let direct writing do more work than decorative interface chrome.
influences.doNotCopy: Do not copy Daring Fireball's exact layout, typography, colors, marks, content, or trade dress.

governance.sourceOfTruth: .shapeable/design-system.json after adoption; this central artifact remains the generated draft and audit record.
governance.versioning: Semantic versioning. Patch clarifies without changing identity, minor adds compatible tokens or patterns, major changes the visual or product language.
governance.adoption: Owner approval is required before Shapeable writes the pack into skill.supply or adds the managed Claude import. Adoption must preserve unrelated repository instructions and include rollback.
governance.deviations: Record intentional deviations beside the affected pattern with rationale, evidence, owner, and a review date. Do not silently fork tokens.
governance.reviewCadence: Review after each accepted Shapeable cure, after a material product-positioning change, and at least every six months.

readFirst: Read NORTH_STAR.md, brand.md, and .shapeable/design-system.json before changing product-facing design.
Treat this site's identity and product boundaries as constraints, not optional inspiration.
Inspect the current implementation and audit evidence before proposing a visual change.
decisionRules: Choose the smallest reversible change that fixes the highest-impact measured problem.
Preserve Skill Supply's editorial transfer-market identity while improving usability.
Use indigo as a scarce signal, never as generic chrome or a decorative surface.
Prefer fewer elements, stronger hierarchy, plain language, and real evidence.
Design mobile and desktop together and verify both on the identical audit matrix.
When evidence and owner direction conflict, stop and request owner review.
forbidden: Do not apply Shapeable's palette, layout, typography, or visual motifs.
Do not genericize the product into a card-heavy SaaS dashboard.
Do not introduce gradients, decorative AI art, recruiting stock photography, or HR cliches.
Do not copy proprietary assets, layout, source code, screenshots, or trade dress from an influence.
Do not invent claims, placements, profiles, proof, or testimonials.
Do not send applications or external messages, and do not imply that the agent did.
Do not overwrite brand.md, CLAUDE.md, or unrelated repository instructions without explicit owner-approved adoption.
reviewChecklist: The 390x844 and 1440x900 profiles both show zero horizontal overflow and zero clipped essential content.
Essential labels are at least 12px, every control is at least 24px, and primary mobile actions are comfortable at 44px.
Keyboard, focus, status announcements, contrast, and reduced motion pass.
Claims have evidence and candidates-never-pay language is unambiguous.
The candidate retains explicit control of every external action.
The result still looks and sounds unmistakably like Skill Supply, not Shapeable or another influence.
Build, bounded lint comparison, protected preview, identical rescan, rollback, and human visual review are recorded.

runnableEvidence.expected: The Skill Supply production build completes without a new error.
The configured mobile and desktop matrix reaches 100/100 with 100% coverage, sufficient confidence, and no material regression.
